title: Agentic mandate (JWT claims set)
description: Claims carried in an EdDSA-signed JWT (typ: mandate+jwt). Documentation only: the gateway reads the `required` claims and ignores the rest.

iss.description: Issuer URL. Must resolve in the trust registry.

cnf.description: Proof-of-possession key of the delegate (RFC 7800). The agent signs each request with this key.

agent_id.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of cnf.jwk, or any stable id

clearance.description: Highest data level this mandate may call (1 public, 2 basic PII, 3 sensitive PII, 4 special category). Checked by gateway/lib/interfaces.py against each server's level. Absent: no check on pupil-data, CLEARANCE_MISSING on interface servers. The 'audit' server is level 2.

server.description: MCP server name as exposed by the gateway

constraints.description: Argument constraints: each key must appear in tool arguments with a value in the given list

scope.description: Grants, one per entry. An audit-reader mandate uses server 'audit' (answered by the gateway itself, data level 2, so it needs clearance >= 2): {"server": "audit", "tools": ["events", "saw"], "constraints": {"principal": ["officer:jsmith"]}} or constraints {"jti": [...]}. See docs/audit-trail.md.

deny.description: Glob patterns over 'server.tool'; deny always wins over scope

counts.description: Safe counts for pupil-data.aggregate (docs/safe-counts.md). The gateway always refuses identifier columns, level-4 columns without clearance 4, more than 2 group_by columns and where on level 3-4 columns; it counts distinct pupils, drops groups smaller than k, hides counts and complements of 1-4, and rounds to 5. This claim can only make it stricter.

k.description: Minimum pupils per released group; values below the default 10 are ignored.
